verdicts.reason: A keeps a dominant headline and a sensible can-left/copy-right banner split. But the RSVP CTA is shrunk into a small pill crammed among the badges in the top-right corner, and 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' has dropped below the URL line, so the reading order is reversed. The centered text stack is cramped and the legal line is illegibly small. B makes 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' nearly as loud as the headline, so the two compete for attention, and it puts the tagline above the date. The RSVP button is the same weight as the badges in one row, and the missing-asset placeholder sits prominently mid-canvas. The 'Reserve a spot' and legal text are tiny, and the can is shrunk into a corner.
